 Print Attachment Gorakhpur : Chief minister Yogi Adityanath on Thursday completed the online self-enumeration process under the second phase of Census 2027 in UP and appealed to people to participate in the exercise before the Nov 30 deadline. Yogi filled out the online self-enumeration form at his residence in the Gorakhnath temple premises in Gorakhpur. He accessed the self-enumeration portal and entered his details in all 40 questions of the questionnaire, completing every section of the form. State principal census officer Sheetal Verma was present on the occasion. Appealing to people across the state to actively participate in the exercise, the chief minister said self-enumeration was a national responsibility. In a post on social media platform X, Yogi said, “Self-enumeration is a national task. Today (Thursday), in Gorakhpur, I completed my self-enumeration process under Census 2027. A census is not merely a counting of the population but also the foundation for understanding the needs and aspirations of every citizen and planning for a better future.” He urged all citizens of the state to participate enthusiastically and contribute to the important exercise aimed at building a developed India and a developed.
